fieldValues.title: Convention before enforcement
fieldValues.decision_question: How do we adopt a new preferred practice, such as one filename scheme for definitions?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's working session on 2026-10-10 (the owner was away from a computer); awaiting the owner's ratification. srs-rust#1209: two filename slug schemes exist for definitions. One way per goal says pick one, but forcing it everywhere at once means churn and may be wrong.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: Enforce one scheme everywhere now; keep both schemes indefinitely; convention first, then enforce once proven. Chosen: convention first.
fieldValues.decision_statement: A new norm starts as a convention: a stated preferred route that new work follows, used as a test, with a review clause. When it has proven itself (consistently used, adds value), a separate decision enforces it across the board; otherwise it is withdrawn.
fieldValues.rationale: Rules should arrive already tried. Enforcing an unproven rule everywhere costs churn and may enforce the wrong thing.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When the first conventions adopted under this principle reach their review (srs-rust#700 after four weeks): did the convention route work?
fieldValues.next_steps: WG Third-party ready proposes one slug scheme as a convention, with proving criteria, no renames: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/issues/1209
